decision_summary: Approve v0.4.1 fixture coverage expansion as the next implementation slice.
rationale: Validated need, roadmap evidence, and v0.4.0 fixture precedent support extending retained negative coverage beyond quality-gate before adding new conceptual features.
recommendation: Implement a generalized fixture runner and selected qif-package/expert-judgment negative fixtures, then verify with npm test and AOF runtime checks.
expected_user_reaction: Trust that v0.4.1 is a hardening release, not a semantic expansion.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add fixtures and runner updates only where they enforce existing structural rules.
organization_change_recommendations: Continue using latest AOF and latest QIF to gate QIF work.
